world.title: Trump says Canada wants 'benefits' of being US state after trade talks collapse
world.description: Canada's PM said he was "reluctantly" announcing retaliatory tariffs and accused the US of starting a trade war.

world.title: Zelensky has 'questions to answer' about corruption in his government, sacked minister tells BBC
world.description: The sacked former defence minister has also called for elections to be held in Ukraine.

world.title: Girl, 17, killed in Swedish sword attack, police say
world.description: Two boys aged 12 and 17 were also injured, while an 18-year-old suspect has been detained.

world.title: Father leaves 7-year-old son alone on Mount Fuji to continue hike
world.description: The man had taken his two boys on the trip but is said to have left one behind when he got tired.

world.title: The hotel booking mix-up that could free mushroom murderer
world.description: A table tennis tournament and a throat lozenge could help Erin Patterson's lawyers overturn her convictions.

world.title: Dozens of co-ordinated arson attacks hit southern Thailand
world.description: No group has claimed responsibility for the attacks, which the military said "aimed at creating unrest".

world.title: Trump Mobile promoted a 'Made in the USA' phone - but the details kept changing
world.description: BBC Verify tracks the changes in design, spec, manufacture and release date of the T1 phone from Trump Mobile.

world.title: Robots compete in boxing, football and sprinting at World Humanoid Games
world.description: The second-edition of the five-day competition kicked off in Beijing, China, on Saturday.

world.title: Rescuers dig through Ukraine mall wreckage as Zelensky condemns 'despicable' Russian strike
world.description: Four people are still missing after Friday's attack which killed 16 and left 130 injured, including a number of children.

world.title: Syria says Israeli strike near Damascus violation of international law
world.description: The latest incident comes days after reports emerged Israel had struck a military airbase close to the Turkish border.

world.title: 'We're not going to run from it': Sydney Marathon laughs off medal error
world.description: Runners will receive a medal at the 2026 Sydney Marathon with an engraving of a German stadium.

world.title: Fourteen killed in strike on Myanmar monastery
world.description: A rescue worker said the site had been struck twice as civilians gathered for a meditation retreat.

world.title: US military newspaper editor voices censorship fears after being fired
world.description: Erik Slavin believes he was fired for saying in an interview that "in a hypothetical situation, censorship would be a red line".

world.title: TikTok to pay $400m to US in one of largest child privacy settlements
world.description: The deal stems from a 2024 lawsuit alleging TikTok and its parent company ByteDance collected "vast amounts of data" on millions of users under the age of 13.

world.title: Israel re-establishes closed West Bank settlement, defying growing international protests
world.description: Thirty "pioneer families" have arrived on a wave of nationalism driven by Israel's government, but the rapid change has left nearby Palestinian residents fearful.

US.title: Body cam shows federal agent was 'unjustified' in Memphis shooting, attorney says
US.description: The family of Jonah Neal and their attorney were recently shown video from the day that Neal was shot by a federal agent while he experienced a mental health crisis.

US.title: Trump administration's 75-country visa ban was illegal, judge rules
US.description: The U.S. stopped issuing visas for citizens of 75 countries because it said they were likely to need public assistance. A judge ruled the policy illegally discriminated on the basis of nationality.

US.title: Opinion: Mr. Rogers keeps finding a new neighborhood
US.description: MLB catcher Jake Rogers probably didn't know if he was coming or going the last several weeks: he's been a Detroit Tiger, a Baltimore Oriole, a Boston Red Sox, and now he's a Chicago Wh

US.title: As Flock battles public scrutiny, other police surveillance companies see an opening
US.description: Dozens of cities have canceled their contracts with Flock. Some are switching to other companies, but privacy experts say they're no better than Flock.

US.title: Hours after U.S. imposes tariffs, Canada says it'll strike back starting Sept. 8
US.description: The U.S. has now imposed 50% tariffs on $20 billion worth of Canadian products. Prime Minister Mark Carney says Canada will match those tariffs "dollar for dollar" next month.

US.title: A battle over 'Italian brainrot' could shape who owns AI art
US.description: A legal battle over what looks like a cartoon stick could help set the rules over whether creators can claim ownership of their AI-generated characters.

US.title: Supreme Court allows Trump's ballroom construction to continue for now
US.description: The ruling comes after months of back-and-forth between the Trump administration and the National Trust for Historic Preservation.

US.title: Beatty files emergency request to stop Trump's name from returning to Kennedy Center
US.description: Joyce Beatty, a Democratic representative from Ohio, asked a federal judge to stop the Kennedy Center trustees from putting President Trump's name up in three places at the arts complex.

US.title: Top Iran official says U.S. focus on economic warfare shows it has failed militarily
US.description: The Iranian regime has dismissed President Trump's threats to crush Iran economically, saying that years of U.S. sanctions have failed.

US.title: Trump declares economic warfare on Iran. And, SCOTUS to rule on White House ballroom
US.description: President Trump has declared economic warfare on Iran in an effort to pressure the country back into negotiations. And, the Supreme Court is set to decide on the future of Trump's ballroom.
